messages:
Maria: Quick sync: capturing owners/timelines for GPU capacity postmortem. Need clear owners for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom policy. I'll consolidate into the postmortem doc.

Devin: I can take scheduler tuning. Plan: prototype binpacking + pod-spread changes, run a 2h staging canary tomorrow, then report results. Target: end of week.

Sophia: I'll own headroom policy (reserve per pool + autoscaler thresholds). Requesting last 7d QPS and P95/P99 latencies to set safe thresholds.

Lee: Pulling telemetry now. Will attach CSV + autoscaler logs to the doc.

Anita: I'll submit the cloud quota request (A100/T4 families). Need monthly GPU estimates + typical vCPU/mem footprints. Maria, can you add the numbers to the doc?

Maria: Added sustained=180 GPUs, burst=260 GPUs and weekday-afternoon spike notes. Added links to the draft postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-GPU_CAPACITY: postmortem draft created (confluence link). Logs auto-attached.

Devin: Current binpack threshold is 0.8. Proposal: lower to 0.65, enable soft eviction at 0.75 to keep a buffer. Will validate on staging.

Sophia: Rollout plan for headroom: 1) conservative thresholds to non-critical pools within 48h, 2) monitor 72h, 3) full rollout in 2 weeks. Add a rollback plan with canary metrics?

Devin: Yes — canary metrics: pending pods, P95 latency, GPU util. If P95 > baseline+20% or pending pods spike >10, rollback.

Anita: Quota approval usually 5 business days. Submitted today (INC-4567). Will request temporary burst increases if we need immediate headroom.

Lee: Uploaded telemetry to /attachments/telemetry-7d.csv and autoscaler logs. Also added a small repro: python tools/loadgen.py --clients 80 --rps 20 --duration 3600 --model gpt-rr-small

Sophia: Also adding monitoring alerts: token-level latency P95, pending pods per nodepool, and sustained GPU utilization. I'll post alert configs in the doc.

Maria: Created a recurring monthly audit ticket for autoscaler thresholds and will assign to Platform oncall. Also setting a 2-week follow-up check after rollout.

Devin: Staging window booked tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PST. Invites sent.

Anita: Quota approval pending. I'll paste approval ID when it comes through.

Maria: Action summary added to the postmortem doc: headroom policy (Sophia), scheduler tuning (Devin), quota (Anita), telemetry export (Lee), recurring audit (Maria). I'll move this into the remediation timeline and will ping owners for updates in 24h. :thumbsup:
